interpretations: Minimalist S2 emits two caster shots at both model attack events. Each release also emits Funnel_s2: original onlyFeedActionsToFirstOne=0 and malist_s_2 cast-on-target trigger support this interpretation, but the executable ON_ABILITY_CAST_ON_TARGET dispatch lifecycle has not been recovered.

Leizi/Astgenne chains hit neighbors during the first impact callback: source chain controllers have interval=0 and waitFirstPeriod=0; exact internal Unity chain renderer traversal is not recovered. Initial projectile speed and no-repeat target selection are preserved.

Amiya normal and S2 use source preDelay values plus fixed .15s projectile flight, rather than the model attack event. Intro/loop FSM transition playback is not reproduced; current renderer plays the source attack clip.

Skyfire normal is direct radius1.1 area damage; S2 is fixed-point radius1.7 with 1.5s lifetime. Meteor source `_selectTargetTiming=1` is interpreted as release-time destination selection. Unity effects/vertical mount transforms are approximated by a tracked descending projectile.
The five kits implement base talents and all selected skills, not optional module upgrades or full original Unity effects.
